snippet.title: Hyper Gauntlet Beta 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hyper Gauntlet will be reaching v1.0 on March 1st, 2014 and will finally be available to buy. As such, a celebratory new trailer is in order.

Music is "Flak" by DST: http://nosoapradio.us
